item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 19/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coast of Guangdong between tomorrow night and Sunday morning. Temperatures will fall appreciably over the region. Under the influence of an intense winter monsoon and upper-air disturbances, the weather will become cold further over southern China early to midweek next week. It will be windy with a few rain patches. The weather will be very cold over Guangdong. Upper-air disturbances will continue to bring rather cool and rainy weather to Guangdong in the latter part of next week. There may be thunderstorms over the region.

Date/Month: 20/01 (Saturday)
Wind: East force 2 to 3, becoming north force 4 later, force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches in the morning and at night. Rather warm with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 18 - 25 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
